title: Felix Firefly and the Three Dark Lanterns | Story for Kids
opening_policy: Four-second illustrated title establish before narration. The first spoken sentence names Felix, the setting and the problem.
audio_policy: Tonal music and band-limited physical effects only. No white-noise wind, wing, brush, shaker or broadband ambience. The music-only opening must measure at or below -65 dB RMS above 12 kHz.
visual_policy: One integrated premium full-frame story composition per scene. No blurred backdrop, pasted character cutout, duplicate character, UI panel or generic sprite stage.

scenes.action: Felix discovers Rabbit and Hedgehog beside exactly three dark lanterns and understands that the path home is lost.
lines: One moonlit evening, Felix found three dark lanterns.
Without their light, the woodland path was lost.

scenes.action: Felix shows gold-blue-gold; Rabbit completes it and the first lantern lights.
lines: The first lantern needed gold, blue, gold.

scenes.action: Hedgehog completes blue-gold-blue and the second lantern lights.
lines: The second lantern needed blue, gold, blue.
Hedgehog placed each step with care.

scenes.action: A gust covers the colour leaves, but the friends remember both patterns together.
lines: Then a gust covered every coloured leaf.
Felix said, we can remember together.

scenes.action: Felix's glow dims; Rabbit shelters him and Hedgehog keeps the two lit lanterns close.
lines: Felix shared so much light, his glow grew small.
Rest here, Felix. We will stay.

scenes.action: The friends join gold-blue-gold-blue and the third lantern lights.
lines: Soon, all three friends joined their patterns.
Gold, blue, gold, blue; the final lantern shone.

scenes.action: The three lit lanterns guide the friends along the winding path toward home.
lines: Three lanterns now marked the winding trail.
Follow us. We know the way home.

scenes.action: The woodland neighbours reach the picnic and celebrate the friends who restored the path.
lines: The woodland neighbours followed the lights to the picnic.
Felix's brave light shone brighter with friends.
